statement: The direct raft-rs checkpoint content owner seals and validates an immutable application-complete v2 M/D/C/N image with exact application schema, rows, outcomes and sequence state, strict bounded canonical bytes, and same-boundary idempotence/conflict, while every production activation path remains parked.

constraints.statement: Source changes require independent verification recorded through Solver before audit and landing.

Scope is snapshot-checkpoint constants, format/codec and store content ownership, plus the narrow install version dispatch needed to retain v1 CREATE and typed-refuse v2 CREATE. Tests, this Quest and its evidence harness are included.

V2 owns immutable manifest, descriptor, payload digest/content and native binding M/D/C/N; it preserves acknowledged application schema, explicit and implicit indexes, rows, transaction and statement outcomes, AUTOINCREMENT high-water, and excludes sender-local Raft, lifecycle, runtime and vote state.

The v2.3 shape-directed detached codec is the only M/D/N byte grammar: Proxy/getter/toJSON/cycle/Unicode and deterministic resource-limit rules apply. The R12 supported-schema compatibility decision remains a required STOP before terminal landing.
The exact same boundary and image is idempotent; the same boundary with changed application bytes is a typed conflict and cannot overwrite the first sealed image.

Do not change snapshot-catchup callback inputs, automatic cadence, native Storage publication or compaction, transfer routing, receiver Ready/application import, lifecycle shutdown, retry/progress, or report_snapshot. The caller census must remain closed.
Fresh CREATE v1 behavior remains supported by its existing admission/install owner. V2 CREATE is typed unsupported before destructive installation and has no legacy or SQL fallback.

Handle checkpoint-store to canonical-format/codec, checkpoint-store read-only consumption of raft-rs durable record and peer identity, and checkpoint-format version to install admission dispatch together. Register exact impact-contract pairs for these interactions before source if the registry lacks them.

This dependency proves content only. Its receipt cannot satisfy the final catch-up Quest, which reruns all R1-R7 on the exact coupled activation head including publication, transport, receiver atomicity, restart, retry and pressure evidence.
